## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset20261703.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## DEFINE MODEL EXPOSURES, OUTCOMES, AND COVARIATES

```{r}

## CORE
  ## Define variables
exposure_vars <- c("childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS_rev", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R")
outcome_vars <- c("GRIM_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")
outcome_vars_gm <- c("globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean")
  ## Define model covariates
covars_c <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 


## HEALTH ONLY
  ## Define model covariates
covars_health <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 

```


## CORE

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_c <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_c <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_c, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_c)
adjusted_mH_summaries_c <- models_summarize(var_combinations_c, adjusted_c)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_c, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_AAcore20262003.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_mH_summaries_c, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_core_AA20262003.xlsx")

```

### Global Methylation

```{r}
## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_gmc <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars_gm)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_gmc <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_gmc, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_c)
adjusted_gmH_summaries_c <- models_summarize(var_combinations_gmc, adjusted_gmc)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(adjusted_gmc, file = "Model_Diagnostics/adjusted_GMcore20262003.RDS")

## Export the data frame
writexl::write_xlsx(adjusted_gmH_summaries_c, "Output/Sensitivity/Adjusted_core_GM20262003.xlsx")

```


## HEALTH ONLY

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_mHm1 <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_mHm1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_mHm1, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_health)
adjusted_mH_summaries_dfm1 <- models_summarize(var_combinations_mHm1, adjusted_mHm1)

# Save as new dataframe

```

### Global Methylation

```{r}
## Create combinations of all outcomes and exposures
var_combinations_gmHm1 <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars_gm)

## Run the adjusted linear regression models and save results in new df
adjusted_gmHm1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations_gmHm1, data = complete_subset, covars = covars_health)

```


## EXPORT RESULTS

```{r}

## write results to single files
sheets_dnamagesensAAGM = list('Core (AA)' = adjusted_mH_summaries_c,
                              'Core (GM)' = adjusted_gmH_summaries_c,
                              'Health Only (AA)' = adjusted_mH_summaries_dfm1,
                              'Health Only (GM)' = adjusted_gmH_summaries_dfm1)
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets_dnamagesensAAGM, 'Output/Adjusted_CORE_HEALTH_AA-GM20262003.xlsx')

```
